notes: Replace the old Submodule.IsLattice assumption and its span_eq_top projection with Submodule.IsFullLattice. This preserves the original hypothesis in this number-field setting: the old class in Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Lattice.lean:70-74 requires exactly L.FG and span E L = top. The target IsFullLattice has these conditions plus linearIndepOn inherited from the new IsLattice. Since E is the fraction field of its ring of integers, target Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Lattice/Basic.lean:187-190) derives the extra condition from L.FG; conversely the target full lattice supplies both old fields. Thus the assumptions are equivalent here. The integer-multiple conclusion is unchanged.
